name: claude-kimi
notes: Claude Code pointed at Moonshot Kimi's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Set MOONSHOT_API_KEY in your environment (or override the reference in answers with env); the harness copies it into ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN for this provider only and clears an inherited ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Use the vendor's model id as the model. No effort flag is sent, because the backend's support for it is unknown. Counts as its own provider for review_policy, separate from Anthropic. Regional endpoints differ; override ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in answers if yours does.
